subject: Interviewer relay + skill-map activation — urgent PM panel fills
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: PM panel this Thu — need relay plan and quick skill map

Hi all,

Heads up — we just had two interviewers drop for the Thursday PM panel (last-minute illness + travel) and we need to stitch together coverage for a 90-minute loop (3 x 30m interviews) for final-stage candidates. Hiring partner says there are back-to-back slots and candidate availability is tight.

As a stopgap I propose a relay format: each interviewer takes 20 minutes of question time + 10 minutes debrief handoff to the next interviewer. That reduces risk of full no-shows. Can each of you reply with: 1) which segments you can cover (behavior / product sense / execution) and 2) whether you can stay for handoff minutes?

I attached a quick skill-map CSV with suggested pairings based on past debriefs — feel free to update.

If we can't fully cover, I will loop in others, but please reply within the hour so I can confirm with Amelia and the candidate.

Thanks —
Lauren
Hiring Manager, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: skill-map-rotations.csv

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: PM panel this Thu — need relay plan and quick skill map

Lauren —

I can take the product-sense segment and stay for handoffs. I ran the attached CSV against my recent panels and marked rows where I led similar questions (columns: domain_strength, recent_scorecards). My available window on Thu is 10:30–13:30 PT; I can move later if necessary but prefer earlier.

Notes: for relay to work, we should standardize a 3-question starter for each segment to keep time tight (I can draft). Also recommend we use the debrief-scorecard-template.docx so notes are consistent when we hand off.

-Chloe
Sr. PM, Interviewer Panelist
Redwood Inference

Attachments: skill-map-rotations.csv (updated)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: PM panel this Thu — need relay plan and quick skill map

Can do behavior + execution. I have a late EMEA call so I can cover 11:00–12:30 PT but might need to jump for a 12:30 call (15 min buffer). Happy to take the middle segment (execution deep dive) and I can prepare 3 cross-check follow-ups to hand to the next interviewer.

If the final hour runs late I can tag in Priyom to be shadow backup — he knows the rubric on execution. Adding him now so he sees the thread.

-Marcus
Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>

From: Amelia Ramos <amelia@hiringpartner.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Jordan Lee — availability + resume (Thu panels)

Hi Lauren / Chloe,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Jordan Lee confirmed Thu availability 11:00–13:00 PT and is flexible by 30 minutes earlier/later if that helps. Resume attached. They prefer back-to-back panels without long gaps.

If you need to shift anything, I can ask Jordan to accept a 10:20 start. Otherwise please confirm final schedule and I will send calendar invites.

Best,
Amelia Ramos
Talent Partner, ScoutWorks

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amelia Ramos <amelia@hiringpartner.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final schedule + relay assignments for Thu (confirmed)

Thanks everyone — confirmed with Amelia and Jordan. Final plan is below (relay + 10m handoff):

• 10:20–10:40 PT: Chloe — Product sense (3 starter Qs)
• 10:40–11:00 PT: Chloe/Marcus handoff overlap (notes in scorecard)
• 11:00–11:30 PT: Marcus — Execution deep dive (3 starter Qs)
• 11:30–11:40 PT: Handoff to Monica (10m overlap)
• 11:40–12:00 PT: Monica — Behavioral & culture fit (3 starter Qs)

Priyom: please stand by as shadow backup for the final slot — if Marcus needs to drop at 11:30 you’d step in and use the debrief-scorecard-template.docx to preserve continuity.

Action items:
- Marcus: upload your starter questions to the shared sheet by 10:00 Thu (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/skill-map-rotations)
- Chloe: draft the three product-starters and attach to the calendar invite
- Monica: bring two behavioral anchors and use the scorecard template sent earlier

I will create the calendar event and include the candidate + Amelia. Linking the invite here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=pm-panel-relay-20270513

If anything breaks, reply-all immediately and we’ll promote Priyom. Thanks for the fast responses — this relay approach should keep the candidate experience smooth and preserve evaluation fidelity.

-Chloe
Sr. PM, Interviewer Panelist
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: debrief-scorecard-template.docx
